map.印刷在输液器外包装与滴壶（茂菲氏滴管）上，常见标注为「20 滴 ≈ 1 mL」或: The printing is on the outer package of the infusion set and on the drip chamber (burette), commonly marked as "20 drops ≈ 1 mL" or "15 gtt/mL". Micro-drip sets are 60 gtt/mL and are often used in pediatrics and vasoactive drugs. Different manufacturers and batches can differ, so reconfirm whenever the device is changed instead of relying on experience.
map.对同一数值做千进制倍率换算（×1 / ×0.001 / ×1000），用于单位量: Do a decimal-scale factor conversion of the same value (x1 / x0.001 / x1000) to switch magnitude units.
map.已知输液总量与滴系数，先算总滴数，再按计划时长换算每分钟滴数。: Given the total infusion volume and the drop factor, first compute the total drops and then convert to drops per minute for the planned duration.
map.把 mL/h 与滴/分互相换算，用于核对输液泵设置与重力滴注的实际流速是否一致。: Convert between mL/h and drops/min to check whether the infusion pump setting matches the actual flow of a gravity drip.
map.按液体量、滴系数与时长计算输液滴速（滴/分）或预计结束时间，用于护理配液核对，纯: Compute the infusion drip rate (drops/min) or the expected finish time from the volume, drop factor and duration, for nursing verification; the front-end calculation is not a medical order.
map.滴系数在哪里看？: Where do I find the drop factor?
map.用输液泵时以 mL/h 为准，滴数只作为断电或重力滴注时的备用核对手段。但换用普: When using an infusion pump, mL/h is authoritative and drop counting is only a backup check during power loss or gravity drip. But when switching to a standard set, on pump failure or on transport switched to gravity drip, the drops per minute must be recalculated from the drop factor; also note that patient position, kinked tubing and fluid level all make the actual gravity flow deviate from the calculated value, so periodic re-checking is needed.
map.输液泵设定 mL/h 后还需要数滴数吗？: After setting the infusion pump in mL/h, do I still need to count drops?
map.静脉输液滴速与时间换算（已有但加强） 使用指南: IV Infusion Drip Rate and Time Conversion User Guide
map.：500 mL 液体、滴系数 15、计划 4 小时输完：总滴数 = 500 ×: : 500 mL of fluid with a drop factor of 15 over a planned 4 hours: total drops = 500 x 15 = 7500 drops; drops/min = 7500 / 240 = 31.25 ≈ 31 drops/min; mL/h = 500 / 4 = 125.0 mL/h. With a drop factor of 20: total drops = 10000, drops/min = 41.7 ≈ 42, while mL/h stays 125.0. The magnitude conversion part is computed as "output value = input value x conversion factor x source magnitude / target magnitude", with magnitude steps of 1 / 0.001 / 1000; for example input 500, factor 15, source magnitude 1 and target magnitude 0.001 gives the output 7500000.000000, which is the drop-denominated total (7500) expressed at the 0.001 magnitude, so confirm the target magnitude is the one you need before using it.
map.：总滴数 = 液体总量(mL) × 滴系数(gtt/mL)；滴/分 = 总滴数: : total drops = total volume (mL) x drop factor (gtt/mL); drops/min = total drops / total infusion minutes; mL/h = total volume / infusion hours = drops/min x 60 / drop factor. Common drop factors: standard sets 10, 15, 20 gtt/mL; micro-drip sets 60 gtt/mL. With a drop factor of 15, 1 mL ≈ 15 drops, so 125 mL/h is about 31 drops/min.
